hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLOUT_RUN_ID
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Immutable combined-pipeline run identity for the forward banner artifact.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLBACK
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Build the exact old frontend artifact selected by a FRONTEND_ALLOWED attestation.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLBACK_ATTESTATION_JSON
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Machine-checkable rollback state. Do not include secrets.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}" : "${S3_BUCKET_NAME:?S3_BUCKET_NAME is required}"
artifact_prefix="${TARGET_STACK}/containers" if [[ "${BANNER_ROLLBACK:-false}" == "true" ]]; then [[ -z "${BANNER_ROLLOUT_RUN_ID:-}" ]] || { echo "ERROR: frontend rollback cannot include a forward run identity." >&2; exit 2; } [[ -n "${BANNER_ROLLBACK_ATTESTATION_JSON:-}" ]] || { echo "ERROR: frontend rollback build requires a FRONTEND_ALLOWED attestation." >&2; exit 2; } rollback_attestation=$(mktemp) trap 'rm -f "${rollback_attestation}"' EXIT printf '%s' "${BANNER_ROLLBACK_ATTESTATION_JSON}" > "${rollback_attestation}" python3 "${JENKINS_HOME}/banner-rollout/validate-banner-rollout.py" \ --rollback-attestation "${rollback_attestation}" \ --jenkins-source-commit "${JENKINS_SOURCE_COMMIT}" \ --controller-deployment "${BANNER_CONTROLLER_DEPLOYMENT}" \ --target-stack "${TARGET_STACK}" \ --required-rollback-stage FRONTEND_ALLOWED artifact_prefix=$(jq -r '.artifactPrefix' "${rollback_attestation}") attested_frontend_commit=$(jq -r '.artifacts.frontendCommit' "${rollback_attestation}") if [[ "${GIT_COMMIT}" != "${attested_frontend_commit}" ]]; then echo "ERROR: checked-out frontend commit does not match the rollback attestation." >&2 exit 2 fi elif [[ -n "${BANNER_ROLLOUT_RUN_ID:-}" ]]; then [[ "${BANNER_ROLLOUT_RUN_ID}" =~ ^combined-[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "ERROR: invalid banner rollout run identity." >&2; exit 2; } artifact_prefix="${TARGET_STACK}/banner-rollout/forward/${BANNER_ROLLOUT_RUN_ID}/containers" fi
GIT_BRANCH_SHORT=$(echo "${GIT_BRANCH}" | awk -F/ '{print $NF}') GIT_COMMIT_SHORT=$(echo "${GIT_COMMIT}" | cut -c1-7)
aws s3api get-object --bucket "${S3_BUCKET_NAME}" --key "configs/pic-sure-frontend/bdc.env" .env aws s3api get-object --bucket "${S3_BUCKET_NAME}" --key "configs/pic-sure-frontend/configuration.json" configuration.json
cp -f configuration.json ./src/lib/assets/configuration.json
frontend_image="hms-dbmi/pic-sure-frontend:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}_${TARGET_STACK}" docker build --no-cache --load -f Dockerfile --build-arg THEME="${THEME}" -t "${frontend_image}" . docker save "${frontend_image}" | gzip > pic-sure-frontend.tar.gz if [[ "${artifact_prefix}" == "${TARGET_STACK}/banner-rollout/"* ]]; then artifact_run_id="${artifact_prefix%/containers}" artifact_run_id="${artifact_run_id##*/}" aws s3api put-object \ --bucket "${S3_BUCKET_NAME}" \ --key "${artifact_prefix}/pic-sure-frontend.tar.gz" \ --body pic-sure-frontend.tar.gz \ --server-side-encryption AES256 \ --metadata "git-commit=${GIT_COMMIT},rollout-run=${artifact_run_id}" \ --if-none-match '*' else aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp pic-sure-frontend.tar.gz "s3://${S3_BUCKET_NAME}/${artifact_prefix}/pic-sure-frontend.tar.gz" --metadata "git-commit=${GIT_COMMIT},rollout-run=standard" fi
